title: Add benchmark-lab mixed-workload runners and reporting pipeline (v66)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: the benchmark lab needs a representative mixed-workload runner that captures realistic multi-tenant traffic patterns (concurrent chat, batched embeddings, and short generation). This PR implements v66 of the mixed-workload runners, adds a reporting pipeline that aggregates latency/throughput/profiling baselines, and wires the pipeline into CI so nightly runs publish to the reporting datastore. Changes are designed to be backwards-compatible with the existing profiling baselines and support easy extension for new workload variants. Checklist: - [x] Implement mixed workload runner (chat + embeddings + short gen) - [x] Add reporting pipeline config and dashboard templates - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] Add CI job to schedule nightly runs - [x] Update docs with runner configuration and metrics mapping Implementation notes: the runner is implemented in benchmark-lab/runners/mixed_workload_runner.py and introduces a WorkloadSpec layer to parameterize mixes by p95 request size, concurrency, and prefix cache hit rate. The reporting pipeline (benchmark-lab/pipelines/reporting/v66/pipeline.yaml) normalizes metrics to the existing schema used by the reporting datastore and emits per-run profiling artifacts (perf traces, memory snapshots) to s3://redwood-bench-archives/v66/. To minimize runtime flakiness the runner uses a locality-aware routing shim to pin requests to the same placement group for the duration of a run. Backwards compatibility: existing profiling baselines are untouched; v66 is an additive pipeline. Rollout plan: land on main behind feature flag BENCH_V66, enable nightly orchestration in CI, run two internal smoke campaigns and compare to v65 baselines before enabling public dashboards. Related: ENG-4821 (mixed workload spec), ENG-4899 (reporting pipeline schema v2).

release_notes: Add v66 mixed-workload runners and reporting pipeline. Introduces WorkloadSpec parameterization and nightly CI orchestration. No breaking changes. Additive metrics emitted to benchmarking datastore under v66 namespace.
notes_for_merging: Merged behind feature flag BENCH_V66. Nightly CI job enabled and initial internal smoke runs completed. Public dashboards will remain disabled until v65->v66 regression checks pass for two consecutive runs.
